anchors.title: Kings Park & Botanic Garden
anchors.description: One of the world's largest inner-city parks at 400 hectares. The DNA Tower, Lotterywest Federation Walkway and the State War Memorial all have sweeping views over the Swan River and the city skyline.

anchors.title: Cottesloe Beach
anchors.description: Perth's most loved beach — a wide arc of white sand with a heritage pavilion, palm-lined Marine Parade and the legendary Indiana Tea House. Famous for its spectacular sunset over the Indian Ocean.

anchors.title: Rottnest Island — Day Trip with Quokkas
anchors.description: Half-hour ferry from Fremantle to the car-free island home of the famously happy quokka. Pedal a hire bike around the 22km perimeter, snorkel pristine bays and learn the island's complex history.

anchors.title: Elizabeth Quay & The Bell Tower
anchors.description: Perth's revitalised inner-harbour precinct with a 2.6km riverside promenade, water playgrounds and BHP Water Park. The Bell Tower houses one of the world's largest sets of change-ringing bells.

anchors.title: Perth Mint Gold Pour
anchors.description: Watch a $400,000 gold bar poured live at the historic Perth Mint, in continuous operation since 1899. The world's largest coin (a 1-tonne gold piece) is on permanent display.

anchors.title: Swan Valley Wine Region
anchors.description: Western Australia's oldest wine region is just 25 minutes from the CBD. 40+ cellar doors plus craft breweries, distilleries and farm-gate produce along the 32km Swan Valley Food and Wine Trail.

FRIDAY.title: Fremantle Markets
FRIDAY.description: Heritage-listed Fremantle Markets, open Friday, Saturday and Sunday since 1897. 150 stalls of fresh produce, fashion, crafts and Asian street food. Live buskers across the cappuccino strip.
FRIDAY.venue: Cnr South Tce & Henderson Street, Fremantle

SATURDAY.title: Fremantle Markets
SATURDAY.description: Fremantle's iconic weekend market — produce hall + makers' wing + street-food courtyards. Open Saturday and Sunday 8am-6pm.
SATURDAY.venue: Cnr South Tce & Henderson Street, Fremantle

SUNDAY.title: Sunday Sessions at Little Creatures
SUNDAY.description: Live music every Sunday from 2pm on the lawn outside the Little Creatures Brewery in Fremantle. Wood-fired pizza, hand-pulled ales and a view across the fishing-boat harbour.
